question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (1)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**on**" is used to indicate direction towards someone or something. (पर)
 
• In this context, it means making an impression "on" your colleagues and supervisors, which is correct and relevant.
 
• The other options: "**by**," "**for**," and "**inon**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *When you start a new job, you want to make a good impression **on**__ your colleagues and supervisors.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **By (द्वारा/से)**: means identifying the agent performing an action. It is not suitable in this context.
 
• **For (के लिए)**: means indicating the use or purpose of something. It is not appropriate here.
 
• **Inon**: is not a valid word in English and is therefore incorrect.
